# Validation

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "sdwba",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Theory = "sdwba-theory.html",
    Implementation = "sdwba-implementation.html",
    Benchmarks = "sdwba-benchmarks.html",
    Validation = "sdwba-validation.html"
  )
)
```

SDWBA is checked on weak finite-cylinder cases with stochastic controls fixed so residuals reflect the deterministic kernel.

::: {.tip data-title="Residuals near nulls"}
Mean absolute differences describe the typical agreement; maximum differences are retained because deep nulls can expose localized convention or resolution errors.
:::
